intent.description: 中文优先的 PPT 总调度 Skill：根据内容来源、受众、编辑性、交付格式和视觉风险，在原生可编辑 PPTX、OpenPencil 矢量构图、SVG/HTML 到 PPTX、浏览器 HTML PPT、图片型 PPT、手绘技术页、Bento 单页、动画演示和配图资产路线之间选择合适的执行器；网页/URL 默认只作为来源材料，不自动路由 Bento；一页 PPT 未指定版式时先给出推荐风格与可选路线。Use when the user asks to 做PPT、制作演示文稿、生成可编辑PPTX、网页内容转PPT、图片转PPTX、HTML转PPTX、SVG转PPTX、先做HTML再导出PPTX、用OpenPencil做高密度单页、做图片版PPT、Bento单页、PPT配图、流程图、行程图、路线图、架构图、关系图、示意图或统一派发多个PPT Skill。
intent.job_to_be_done: 将多个 PPT、HTML、图片、SVG、动画、模板和 OpenPencil 矢量构图工作流统一派发到最合适的执行器，并以事实、编辑性、渲染和视觉质量门完成交付。

permissions.network: read-only prior-art and source retrieval by default; GitHub publication only after explicit user request
permissions.file_write: project artifacts, reports, and requested local Skill install
permissions.subprocess: route probes and provider-owned validation only; no unreviewed third-party execution
permissions.secrets: never read into public artifacts or reports

governance.rollback_boundary: feature branch and immutable semver release; local sync is recoverable

trust.upstream_adoption: semantic adaptation only; do not vendor upstream source, templates, or private assets

permissions.file_write: requested presentation artifacts, reports, and local Skill maintenance

degradation.openpencil_pptx: probe the actual exporter; if unavailable, keep .op/PNG and use a declared native PPTX fallback such as ppt-master

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what named package, trigger, runtime, install, provider, or human evidence supports
